<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

# Shape targeting all ship instances
vocab:ShipIceClass2010Shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass vocab:ship ;
    
    # Construction contract date must be on/after 2012‑01‑01 and before 2019‑01‑01
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:constructionContractDate ;
        sh:datatype xsd:date ;
        sh:minInclusive "2012-01-01"^^xsd:date ;
        sh:maxExclusive "2019-01-01"^^xsd:date ;
        sh:message "Construction contract date must be between 2012‑01‑01 (inclusive) and 2019‑01‑01 (exclusive) for applicability of the 2010 Ice Class Regulations." ;
    ] ;
    
    # When the date condition is satisfied, the applicable edition must be the 2010 edition
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition ;
        sh:hasValue vocab:iceClassRegulationEdition2010 ;
        sh:message "Ships built under the 2010 Ice Class Regulations must have applicableIceClassRegulationEdition set to iceClassRegulationEdition2010." ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>

We need to produce SHACL shapes implementing the requirement TRF-003: applying Ice Class Regulations of 2010 to ships contracted for construction on/after 1 Jan 2012 but before 1 Jan 2019.

We have ontology terms: applicableIceClassRegulationEdition (object property) domain benchmarkEntity, range iceClassRegulationEditionValue. Also need constructionContractDate datatype property (date) domain benchmarkEntity.

Term owners: applicableIceClassRegulationEdition owned by ship. constructionContractDate owned by ship. iceClassRegulationEdition2010 is a named individual of iceClassRegulationEditionValue.

So shape should target ships (class ship). Condition: constructionContractDate >= 2012-01-01 AND < 2019-01-01. Then require applicableIceClassRegulationEdition = iceClassRegulationEdition2010.

We must use SHACL. Use sh:NodeShape with sh:targetClass ship. Add sh:property for constructionContractDate with sh:datatype xsd:date and sh:minInclusive "2012-01-01"^^xsd:date and sh:maxExclusive "2019-01-01"^^xsd:date. Then a constraint that applicableIceClassRegulationEdition must have value iceClassRegulationEdition2010. Could use sh:property with sh:path applicableIceClassRegulationEdition and sh:hasValue (the individual IRI). Or sh:equals to that node.

Need to use exact IRIs: from ontology evidence. IRI for applicableIceClassRegulationEdition: https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#applicableIceClassRegulationEdition. ConstructionContractDate: https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#constructionContractDate. Ship class: https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ship. iceClassRegulationEdition2010 IRI: https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#iceClassRegulationEdition2010.

Include sh:closed? Not necessary. Provide shapes.

Also include sh:message maybe.

No invented owners etc.
